items.html: *And behold, the coupling of the night, whether the coupling of AVI or the coupling of ZON, since it is inferior to the coupling of the day, must necessarily be for the need of the beginning of the correction of the coupling of the day. For this coupling that is made at night brings about the correction and readiness of the vessel of the Yesod of the Nukva, so that afterward she can raise MAN in that vessel, in the coupling made by day.
